click.core.Context.fail.note: ctx: Context parameters. The many `self.fail(...)` hits in types.py call ParamType.fail, not Context.fail.

click.core.Context.invoke.note: decorators: ctx = get_current_context() (annotated -> Context). `self.invoke(ctx)` in Command.main and `super().invoke` / `sub_ctx.command.invoke` call Command.invoke. decorators.py:63 is inside a docstring.

click.core.Command.make_context.note: Group.invoke: cmd from self.resolve_command (annotated). _resolve_context: cli: Command parameter and cmd from resolve_command.

click.core.Parameter.get_default.note: Option.get_default calls it via super(). Option.get_help_extra / prompt_for_value call self.get_default -> Option.get_default (override), not this.

click.core.Context.get_help.note: Context.get_help itself calls self.command.get_help -> Command.get_help, not itself.

click.core.Group.resolve_command.note: _resolve_context: command = ctx.command, narrowed by isinstance(command, Group).
